content.title: FC Barcelona v Atlético de Madrid - as it happened
content.text: Barcelona v Atletico, Champions League quarter-final first leg, 08/04/2026, confirmed lineups. BeSoccer Join us for our coverage of the first leg of the Champions League quarter-final between Barcelona and Atletico Madrid at the Spotify Camp Nou at 21:00 CET in Barcelona, Spain. List of goalscorers Match report in news End of match FT: Atletico Madrid took a major step towards the Champions League semi-finals with a commanding 2-0 victory over Barcelona at Camp Nou. Ferran Torres comes agonizingly close to scoring but just fails to make contact with the ball! He immediately appeals for a penalty, claiming he was impeded, but the referee waves play on, adamant there was no foul. Substitution at FC Barcelona Flick makes his final move as Alejandro Balde replaces Joao Cancelo. Substitution at Atlético de Madrid Substitution at Atlético de Madrid More changes for Atletico. Griezmann and Giuliano make way for Gonzalez and Almada. A stinging effort from Yamal, but Musso is equal to it! Llorente commits a foul against Lamine Yamal. The referee blows his whistle and gives Barcelona a free-kick. Substitution at FC Barcelona Substitution at FC Barcelona Another double change for Barca as Flick tries to save the tie. Araujo and Ferran Torres come on for Kounde and Rashford. GOOOOOAAAAAL FOR ATLETICO!! It's two for Atletico! Ruggeri whipped a cross to the near post, and Sorloth was there to meet it with his left foot, guiding it into the back of the net to put the visitors firmly in control. Yellow card a FC Barcelona Gavi picks up a yellow card for pulling back Griezmann. Yellow card a Atlético de Madrid Baena picks up a yellow card for repeatedly holding back Olmo. Substitution at Atlético de Madrid Substitution at Atlético de Madrid A double change for the visitors: Lookman and Koke make way for Sorloth and Baena. Yamal crosses the ball into the box. Kounde and Olmo both try to shoot, but they miss the ball. It was a very good chance to score a goal. The hosts are relentless! Despite the numerical disadvantage, Barca are throwing everything at this. Rashford hits a very powerful free-kick. The ball hits the bar after Musso touches it with his fingers. Barca earn a corner kick. A brilliant ball from Yamal finds Rashford in space! The Englishman rounds Musso but runs out of room, and his strike can only find the side-netting from a tight angle. The second half is underway! Barca have 45 minutes to find a way back into this tie. Substitution at FC Barcelona Substitution at FC Barcelona Barcelona make two changes. Gavi and Fermin enter the game, while Pedri and Lewandowski go off. Pubill sees yellow and will miss the second leg of the quarter-finals next week. Goaaaaaal! de Atlético de Madrid en el 45' Statistics of Julián Alvarez in Champions League 0.69 GOOOOOOOOOOAAAAL FOR ATLETICO! Alvarez scores from a free-kick. He hits a powerful shot that Joan Garcia cannot save, giving Atletico the lead against the ten men of Barca. The referee changes the yellow to a red card. Cubarsi must leave the game. Barcelona now have ten players remaining. The referee is checking the monitor for a possible red card! Cubarsi is under the microscope for bringing down Giuliano as the last man. Corner for Barca! Rashford whipped it into the near post, but the red and whites managed to clear the danger. Llorente commits a foul on Pedri. The Barca midfielder is tripped and the referee awards a free-kick to the home side. Yellow card for Koke. He is booked for a foul on Dani Olmo during a midfield battle. Change for Atletico Madrid. Pubill replaces Hancko, who has to leave the pitch due to injury. Another chance for Rashford, but Musso is there to stop him! Hancko is still struggling with his left ankle. Lenglet and Pubil have started warming up on the touchline in case he cannot carry on. Hancko is on the floor. The referee has stopped the game so the medics can enter the field. The Catalans are putting on a fierce press whenever they lose the ball to win it back as quickly as possible. Barca are really pulling the strings in attack and dominating these first twenty minutes, but Atletico are staying solid at the back for now. Goal disallowed Goal disallowed for Barca! Rashford is caught offside, which is a massive shame after a brilliant assist from Yamal. So close for Barcelona! Rashford connects with a sweet volley that looks goal-bound. Giuliano finds a pocket of space and pulls the trigger, but his effort whistles wide of the target. Cancelo tries his luck from distance. It’s a stinging effort, but Musso manages to gather it at the second attempt. Koke leaves one on Dani Olmo! It’s a cynical trip, and while the referee reaches for his whistle, he keeps his cards in his pocket for now. Atletico show their threat! Julian Alvarez forces Joan García into a smart save. Rashford inches away from the opener! He unleashes a thunderbolt, forcing Musso into a world-class stop at full stretch. An early warning shot from Marcus Rashford! He lets fly from range, but it's a routine save for Musso in the Atletico goal. Underway at the Spotify Camp Nou! The first leg of this all-Spanish quarter-final is officially off and running. Start of match The players emerge from the tunnel to a deafening roar! The wait is finally over as these two giants of Spanish football take to the pitch. Final preparations are complete! Both sides have finished their drills, and now it’s time for the talking to stop and the action to begin. An hour to go until the first whistle! It’s a massive night in Catalonia as two Spanish heavyweights go head-to-head for a place in the semi-finals. Atletico starting XI: Musso (GK); Ruggeri, Hancko, Le Normand, Molina; Koke Llorente, Giuliano, Lookman; Alvarez, Griezmann. Barcelona starting XI: Joan Garcia (GK); Kounde, Cubarsi, Gerard Martin, Cancelo; Eric Garcia, Pedri, Olmo; Rashford, Lamine Yamal, Lewandowski. We have the confirmed line-ups for both teams! Let's get started! Istvan Kovacs will be in the middle for this one, Christian Dingert the VAR. Atletico Madrid possible starting lineup: Oblak (GK); Llorente, Le Normand, Hancko, Ruggeri; Koke, Baena; Simeone, Griezmann, Lookman; Alvarez. Barcelona possible starting lineup: Joan Garcia (GK); Kounde, Cubarsi, Martin, Cancelo; Eric Garcia, Pedri; Yamal, Fermin, Rashford; Lewandowski. Here’s how the two sides could line up tonight: With both sides chasing a crucial advantage ahead of the second leg in Madrid, tonight’s encounter promises to be a tense, tactical battle under the Camp Nou lights. Both Jose Gimenez and Cardoso are serious doubts; however, Alvarez is likely to be recalled, joined by Hancko, Lookman and Ruggeri. For Atletico, Oblak, Pubill and Mendoza have returned to training and may take part, although Barrios remains sidelined with a thigh issue. Kounde is expected to start after returning from injury at the weekend, with Lewandowski and on-loan Manchester United attacker Rashford both set to feature in Flick’s frontline. Barcelona will be without Christensen, Raphinha, Frenkie de Jong and Marc Bernal, while Araujo has been passed fit despite his knock in the league encounter. They currently sit fourth in La Liga, comfortably ahead of fifth-placed Real Betis, which allows them to focus squarely on continental and cup commitments. Atlético, led by Diego Simeone, travel to Catalonia on the back of a difficult spell, having suffered three successive defeats in all competitions. Barcelona have only managed one win in their last four Champions League clashes with the Red and Whites, and will be determined to end that run on home soil. However, the Blaugrana’s recent European history against Atlético offers a note of caution – they have lost both of their previous quarter-final meetings with the capital outfit, in 2013-14 and 2015-16. Under Hansi Flick, Barcelona have found strong rhythm, registering five wins from their last six outings in all competitions and showing a clear sense of attacking purpose. The Catalan side head into the match full of confidence after a dramatic 2-1 win over Atlético in La Liga last weekend, with Robert Lewandowski’s late strike extending their advantage to seven points at the top of the domestic table. Pre-match 08 April 2026, 21:00 Referee: István Kovács | VAR: Christian Dingert Stadium: Spotify Camp Nou Hello and welcome to the live coverage of tonight’s Champions League quarter-final first leg between Barcelona and Atlético Madrid at the iconic Camp Nou.
